title: export/manifest.json (schema 1.0)
description: What the delivered dataset holds, the basis of incremental re-export (design doc 06, section 4.3). mcap / lance sources (D44) are exported in full by export/containers.py: dataset_dir names the delivered directory, artifacts name an mcap file or the lance videos with their windows.

dataset_dir.description: the delivered dataset's directory under export/: lerobot_curated when absent, mcap_curated or lance_episodes (D44); artifacts and files are relative to it

fingerprint.description: export fingerprint: passed list and order, task texts and sources, source digest, format and parameters

task.description: the task text written for the episode and where it came from; also in meta/curation_episodes.jsonl of the delivered dataset

artifacts.description: LeRobot: parquet and videos; mcap: file; lance: videos and windows (D44)

chunk.description: v3: linear index of the data file the episode lives in, chunk_index * chunks_size + file_index

windows.description: lance: camera -> [from_ts, to_ts], the episode's window in its video file

files.description: every file of the delivered dataset, relative to export/<dataset_dir>/ (export/lerobot_curated/ by default), with size and sha256; verify reads it back against these
